entities.name: Hovhannes Hovhannisian
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Hovhannes Hovhannisyan was an Armenian poet, translator and educator. While he was not very prolific, his melancholic poetry has been praised for its lyrical quality and form and was influential for subsequent Armenian poets.
